name: The Intern is the Undercover Boss
original_name: The Intern is the Undercover Boss
overview:
Don't underestimate the intern because you don't know her true identity.

To investigate the truth behind a subsidiary's bullying scandal, CEO Claire goes undercover as an intern, enduring humiliation from the villains. With courage and ingenuity, she uncovers the truth, rebuffs the antagonists, and unexpectedly finds love in the process.
